authorization: User now requests running the three models and updating E1; this supersedes earlier documentary-only/E2 training deferral.
scope: First actual DEVELOPMENT experiment. Raw test2025-01-01 through2026-08-31 is reserved and must not be opened by this program.
timing: Registered after development EDA and literature review, before the first project DL fit. Not a claim of registration before observing all historical data.

data.target: sigma_7, population std ddof0 of seven daily log returns, unannualized
data.input: For result dayd use OHLCVdaysd-D..d-1, never result-day inputs.
data.missingness: Preserve calendar and strict exclusion; no imputation or returns through gaps.
data.outer_fit: Static2023 cohort with resultu<=2024-01-01-D-1; no refitting during2024.
data.inner_training: Eligible2023 outcomesu<=2023-10-01-D-1; embargoD also before inner validation

preprocessing.X: Pointwise log of positive OHLC and log1p nonnegativevolume, then five-channel mean/std fitted only on UNIQUE input calendar days covered by admitted training windows; no per-model extra information.
preprocessing.zero_input_std: Replace zero training std by1; retain count.
preprocessing.Y: Divide by positive training mean without centering; invert for all metrics. MSE data loss is scaled by a fixed positive constant within each fit.
preprocessing.stages: Fit on inner-training only for epoch selection; refit independently on allowed full2023 cohort for fixed-epoch training.

models.MLP: FlattenD*5 -> Linear(width) -> ReLU -> Dropout0.1 -> Linear1 -> Softplus
models.LSTM: One unidirectional LSTM layer width -> last hidden -> Dropout0.1 -> Linear1 -> Softplus; two PyTorch biases per gate
models.CNN1D: Two ordinary causal left-padded kernel3 convolutions, no dilation/residual, width channels, ReLU/Dropout0.1 after each -> time mean -> Linear1 -> Softplus

search.selection_statistic: Original-scale RMSE pooled across selection dates per run, then mean across the two search seeds.
search.global_D_rule: For each D choose best configuration per family by mean selectionRMSE, ties exact then fewerparams then configid; choose commonD minimizing mean of these three best family scores, ties smallerD.
search.baseline_identity_rule: Among family winners at commonD, select lowest mean searchRMSE as operational development baseline; never replace it after pilot/development benchmark.

training.refit: Fresh model on allowed full2023 cohort for the best inner epoch count; no warm start
training.batch_order: Deterministic generator seeded with stage seed+17; shuffled windows, chronology of sample construction remains intact

power_and_repetitions.planning_comparison: Each selected network vs deterministic persistence; detect absolute gain delta_plan=0.05*persistenceRMSE(calibration) versus zero; NOT power for exceeding5%.
power_and_repetitions.maximum_rationale: Predeclared resource-bounded first CPU development cycle; if requirement exceeds cap, runcap and report insufficient planning power/MDE, not full power compliance.
power_and_repetitions.power_for_exceeding5percent: Not dimensioned: no q_alt>0.05 has been fixed. Report boundary test separately without claiming planned0.8power.

metrics.mape: Positive targets only, no epsilon; reportcoverage
metrics.mase: Calendar lag1; both labels in allowed full-training cohort; no compressed gaps. Undefined zero/absent scale.
metrics.persistence: sigma7(result_day-1), observable before forecast. Needs8historicalcloses; forD7 this is one extra close beyond the networks sevenOHLCV days. This reference-information difference is disclosed, not silently equated.

analysis.phase: Development/selection/calibration evidence; not final held-out generalization.
analysis.primary_interval: t95 confidence interval for mean runmetric across trainingseeds conditioned on the fixed developmentperiod
analysis.paired_family9: Three two-sided networkpair meanRMSE contrasts; three two-sided networks-vs-persistence; three one-sided relativegain>0.05; Holm over all nine, undefined cases retained without favorable substitutions.
analysis.effect: Cohen dz for pairedseed differences with sign; undefined zeroSD
analysis.assumptions: Shapiro/Q-Qdiagnostics on differences, no favorable test switching
analysis.temporal_DM: Mean squared loss acrossseeds perdate, not ensemblepredictions or meanseedRMSE. BartlettHAC lag14 primary;7/28 sensitivities; HLNh1; fixed longest contiguous eligible segment. Holm primarysixpairs inclpersistence.
analysis.residual_diagnostics: Designated seed1001 only, permodel longest contiguous eligible segment. LjungBoxlags7/14/28 model_df0 justified as non-ARMA-ordered external errors; BDSdimensions2/3 radius1.5sampleSD. Holm across15 diagnostics. No proof of exclusive exploitable nonlinearity.
analysis.bootstrap: Stored predictions only; paired circular dateblocks L14 primary and7/28sensitivities,2000replicates seed20261104, common dates and jointly recalculated numerator/denominator, functional meanseedRMSE. Conditional on realized trainedmodels; doesnot retrain bootstrap pasts.
analysis.descriptive_baseline_vs_test: Development baseline identity frozen from search; no finaltest evaluated in this cycle.

cost_measurement.training: Wall time for innerselection+freshrefit, excluding preprocessing/artifactserialization; validationforward passes included. Pilot/benchmark serializedoneworker,1torchthread. Searchtiming is under3workerconcurrency and separated.
cost_measurement.inference: Original outputs after five warm-up passes,20timedpasses of the same validationinputs, batch256; report mean elapsed for entire phase and per sample. This timing repeats deterministic forwardcomputation, not model selection or independent evaluation.

run_outputs: Code/config/scalers/splits/curves/predictions/weights/runtime metadata and all candidate results retained; failures logged, no replacement seed to improve score.
